src/lib/reward-amount.ts: Pure amount formatting and funded/unfunded labels from supplied fields; no stored state, I/O or transition. Input funding truth is owned by the allocation/registry flow, and formatting is not a proof of funding.
src/lib/reward-asset.mjs: Pure reward-asset choice construction, schema validation and same-object comparison. No I/O or persistent state. Authoritative asset verification and activation remain registry/chain state transitions and are not exempted here.
src/lib/reward-cap.mjs: Pure lookup of a supplied project's exact cycle cap override; no mutation or rollover state. Cap enforcement remains in monthly allocation and vault models.
src/lib/payments/vault-amount.ts: Pure decimal-string to bounded base-unit parsing. No mutable lifecycle; transaction amount and asset identities remain governed by their payment models.
src/lib/penalty-guide.ts: Static guide rows derived from the canonical Slopbot penalty table. This projection has no state transition; penalty application, reversal and funded-award preservation remain modeled elsewhere.
src/lib/project-reward-summary.ts: Pure presentation projection of supplied registry reward/bounty fields; no storage or asynchronous work. Project lifecycle and payment state are not established by this display helper.
src/lib/security-bounty-proposal.ts: Pure construction and preview of an unverified bounty proposal from form inputs. No submission, approval, funding or payment occurs in this module; those state transitions remain API and bounty model responsibilities.
src/lib/points-summary.ts: Pure structural and total/order validation of a supplied summary object; no publication or journal mutation. Points journal and source publication state remain separate models.
workers/referral-accrual/merkle.ts: Pure deterministic Merkle leaf/tree/proof calculation over supplied amounts and addresses; no external state or root posting. This classification does not claim cryptographic correctness or replace the distributor state machine.
src/lib/wallet-proof.ts: Type declarations only for immutable wallet evidence; emitted JavaScript has no runtime state or transitions.
src/lib/wallets.ts: Pure address validation, equality, byte conversion and shortened display. No claim storage, consent or authorization mutation; actual wallet registration/binding remains modeled and is not exempted.
scripts/run-receipt-crypto.ts: Pure schema, hash and Ed25519 verification of supplied receipt bytes. It has no keys, persistence or state transition; a valid signature establishes byte/key continuity only. Receipt completion and upload lifecycles are modeled separately.
contracts/vault-totals.ts: Type-only interface for finalized vault counters. No emitted runtime state; actual atomic reads, identity and reconciliation belong to the EVM/Solana adapters.
src/lib/base-units.mjs: Pure decimal text and bigint formatting/parsing helpers with no I/O, storage or lifecycle. These functions do not establish whether any amount is funded or paid.
src/lib/received-totals.ts: Pure supplied-response shape/arithmetic validator and reviewed USD-asset predicate. No fetch, mutable cache or payment transition; actual receipt indexing and public aggregation remain payment ledger responsibilities.
src/lib/solana-signature.ts: Pure canonical padded-base64 decoder with 64-byte length and round-trip check. No signature verification, challenge consumption, signing or stored state.
src/lib/project-contracts.ts: Domain type declarations, static route constants and pure GitHub identity/path parsing or display copy. No authority lookup, revision mutation or RPC; corresponding service models own those transitions.
scripts/protocol-identity.mjs: Reads and validates one committed protocol identity record against exact legacy/current identifier constants and disabled-activation schema; returns the supplied record or throws. No state mutation, migration, publication or authority lookup occurs; historical immutability is a repository policy outside this validator.
scripts/render-install-guide.mjs: Pure bounded-input Markdown/installer-command rendering and argument parsing. It performs no installation, download, activation or write; generated command state is modeled at the actual installer.
src/lib/verified-money.ts: Pure bigint arithmetic kernels for weighted shares and ordinary/bounty fees. No I/O, mutation or lifecycle; precondition proofs are separate from state refinement and callers enforce input admissibility.
workers/fee-converter/verified-arithmeti: Pure bigint rounding, slippage, remaining-cap, rescaling, spendable balance and gas/impact arithmetic. No quote fetch, signing, journal or payment state; those transitions remain fee conversion models.
scripts/project-revision-policy.mjs: Read-only selection and digest/identity validation over the ordered generated project-revision snapshot. Produces no revision or publication; it assumes upstream snapshot ordering rather than maintaining independent project state.
scripts/published-profiles.ts: Pure retained/current census validation wrapper over supplied profile data and canonical repository inventory. It does not fetch, persist, publish or mutate profiles; current-vs-retained admission is enforced by its existing validators.
